hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); p=d.get('file_path',''); sys.exit(2 if any(x in p for x in ['service-key', '.env']) else 0)"

python3 -c "
import sys, json, subprocess, os
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
p = d.get('file_path', '')
if 'functions/src' not in p or not p.endswith('.ts'):
    sys.exit(1)
fn_dir = p[:p.index('functions/src') + len('functions')]
result = subprocess.run(['npx', 'tsc', '--noEmit'], cwd=fn_dir, capture_output=True, text=True)
print((result.stdout + result.stderr)[-2000:])
sys.exit(result.returncode)
"
